newsitem.title: USA: U.S. calls Iraqi troop movements inconclusive.
newsitem.headline: U.S. calls Iraqi troop movements inconclusive.

text.p: U.S. intelligence has detected the movement of Iraqi forces in northern Iraq, but the shift has been inconclusive, White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said on Tuesday night.
"There has been some movement of units," McCurry said. "We are still analyzing those movements. It is premature for us to make any suggestions about what Saddam Hussein's intentions might be."
"It is too early to have any definitive judgment of those movements, however, we've seen nothing to heighten our concern about further offensive activity," McCurry said at the White House.

The United States on Tuesday launched a cruise missile attack at Iraqi military targets because of Baghdad's incursion over the weekend into its north, where Western allies operate a "no-fly zone" to protect its Kurdish minority.
